# Product document for `scen-check-fix-records-phrase`.
#
# The catalogue phrases every step of E2E-001 but its last; the fix adds
# the entry that phrases "the service answers within 200 milliseconds".

title: "Fixture host project"

description:
  summary: >-
    A single MCP service, used by the bdd-cli fixtures as the host
    project a scenario registry describes.

roles:
  - name: Operator
    definition: Runs the MCP service and watches what it answers.
  - name: Client Developer
    definition: Writes the clients that send the MCP service its requests.

glossary:
  - term: mcp service
    means: >-
      The service this project builds: it takes a message from a client
      and answers it. What every Scenario of the project observes.
  - term: reply
    means: >-
      What the MCP service sends back for one message, and how long it
      took to arrive. A client waits on it, so its content and its delay
      are both behaviour.

catalogue:
  - template: 'the mcp service is running'
    block: given
    means: The MCP service has started and accepts requests.
    terms: [mcp service]
  - template: 'the {actor:role} sends "{message}"'
    block: when
    means: That role sends the quoted message to the MCP service, once.
    terms: [mcp service]
  - template: 'the service answers "{reply}"'
    block: then
    means: The MCP service's reply to the message is exactly the quoted text.
    terms: [mcp service, reply]
  - template: 'the service answers within {limit:number} milliseconds'
    block: then
    means: >-
      The MCP service's reply to the message of the When step arrives no
      later than {limit} milliseconds after that message was sent. The
      delay is measured at the sender as one round trip for that single
      message: it starts the moment the message is sent and ends the
      moment the complete reply has arrived.
    terms: [mcp service, reply]
